title: Project Context
subtitle: Every .md document in this repository's clone. Read one, edit it, or write a new one — and attach any of them to an agent or a skill to put it into a review prompt.

footer.bounded: Only the first {count} documents were scanned

state.noCloneBody: DevDigest clones a repository in the background. This page fills in as soon as the clone is on disk.
state.failedBody: The previous result is still shown below.

empty.title: No .md documents found
empty.body: Nothing under {roots} in this repository. Write a document here, upload a .md, or change the folders in Settings → Project Context.

reader.placeholder: Select a document to read it.
reader.tooLongToEdit: Longer than 40 000 characters, which is the most a save can write. This document can be read here, but not edited.
reader.tooLongToSave: Too long to save. A document is capped at 40 000 characters and this text is over it, so nothing was written.
reader.saveOutsideRoots: This document’s folder is not one of the scanned roots any more, so DevDigest will not write to it. Add the folder back in Settings → Project Context, or copy the text into a document under .devdigest/.

read.missing: missing — this document is not in the clone
read.refused: refused — DevDigest would not read this file
read.binary: binary — this file is not text, so there is nothing to render

create.title: New document
create.pathHint: Created under .devdigest/ in this repository's clone. Sub-folders are fine; the name has to end in .md.
create.exists: A document already exists at this path. Nothing was overwritten — pick another name.
create.invalidPath: That path is not allowed. Use a relative path under .devdigest/ that ends in .md, with no .. segment.
create.tooLarge: Too long to save. A document is capped at 40 000 characters.

folder.title: New folder
folder.pathHint: Created under .devdigest/ in this repository's clone. Nested folders are fine; a folder name does not end in .md.
folder.createdEmpty: Folder created. It holds no .md yet, so the list will not show it until you put a document in it.

upload.binary: That file is not text. Upload a .md document.

local.body: This document exists only in this clone on this machine: it is not in the repository, no colleague and no other clone or run of DevDigest can see it, and it is gone if this repository ever has to be cloned again.

stale.body: The text shown here came from the branch. The edit saved in DevDigest is gone — a resync returned the file to the state of the branch, and no copy of the edit was kept.

tracked.title: This document is tracked by git
tracked.body: It comes from the repository, not from .devdigest/. The next resync of this repository runs `git reset --hard origin/{branch}`, which returns the file to the state of the branch and erases this edit with no trace and no question. DevDigest keeps no copy of it.

write.cloneNotReady: DevDigest is still preparing the clone of this repository. Creating, uploading and saving become available as soon as it is on disk.

attach.title: Project context
attach.orderHint: Checked documents are sent in this order. Drag a row, or use the arrows.
attach.empty: This repository has no scanned documents yet.
attach.noRepo: Select a repository to attach its documents.
attach.inheritedHint: These come from the skills bound to this agent. Edit them on the skill.
attach.skillInherit: Every agent that binds this skill inherits these documents, after its own.
attach.overBudget: Over budget by {overage} tokens. You can still save; documents that do not fit are dropped from the prompt, in order.
attach.perPrompt: Counted once per prompt. This agent runs {strategy}, so the block is assembled again for every changed file.
